One plastic tea bag can release billions of microplastic particles into a single cup.

The fix costs nothing extra. Loose leaf and a steel infuser takes plastic out of the brewing path entirely.

https://plasticdetox.org/articles/how-to-avoid-microplastics-in-tea.html

Polyester is plastic, and every wash sheds hundreds of thousands of microplastic fibres.

They do not only end up in waterways. They end up in your indoor air and house dust, which is how you breathe them.

https://plasticdetox.org/articles/microplastics-in-clothing-and-laundry.html

Microwave safe is a melting standard, not a health one.

It means the container will not warp. It says nothing about what leaches into your food when you heat it.

Borosilicate glass sidesteps the question entirely.

https://plasticdetox.org/articles/best-plastic-free-food-storage-containers.html

The kimchi headlines got it backwards.

That study tested one isolated bacterial strain in germ free mice, not kimchi the food.

No human study shows you can clear plastic particles already sitting in your tissues.

https://plasticdetox.org/articles/can-you-detox-microplastics.html

Bottled water averages roughly 240,000 plastic particles per litre.

Most are nanoplastics: the fraction small enough to cross into tissue, and the fraction almost no filter is tested against.

https://plasticdetox.org/articles/how-to-remove-microplastics-from-bottled-water.html

NSF 401 certifies a filter against microplastics.

There is no equivalent standard for nanoplastics, which is the size that actually crosses membranes.

Certification has not caught up to the particles that matter most.

https://plasticdetox.org/articles/can-nanoplastics-be-filtered-out-of-water.html

The part of chewing gum that never gets smaller is a plastic polymer.

It hides behind one ingredient line reading gum base. That is the entire disclosure you are given.

Chicle based brands are the way around it.

https://plasticdetox.org/articles/best-plastic-free-chewing-gum.html

BPA free does not mean safe.

Manufacturers swapped in BPS and BPF, which are structurally similar and show similar hormonal activity in lab studies.

The label changed. The chemistry barely did.

https://plasticdetox.org/articles/bpa-free-is-not-safe.html
